observation_summary: The Partial constructor throws an exception or fails unexpectedly when handling unsupported duration fields in the types array, specifically when comparing fields that lack a range duration type.
reasoning_summary: The fix introduces new conditional checks (if-statements) to validate the support status of duration fields and ensure that the types array is ordered correctly, preventing invalid comparisons or duplicate unsupported fields. This is a classic case of missing validation logic (guards) for edge cases in the input data.
evidence_used: The fix adds 'if (loopUnitField.isSupported() == false)' to validate the input types array.
The fix adds 'if (lastUnitField.isSupported())' to provide specific error messages for ordering violations.
The fix modifies the comparison logic to include 'lastUnitField.equals(loopUnitField)' to refine the existing check.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the logic was updated, the primary mechanism of the fix is the addition of guards to validate the input state before proceeding with the comparison, which is the definition of Checking.
